A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunner]] with the [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]], and served as the leader of [[Bantha Squad (Clone Wars)|Bantha Squad]], a special unit formed to counter the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance's]] [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droid tanks]]. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] was an expert in heavy weapons and demolitions, which made him specially qualified to create tactics that succeeded against the droid forces. The commander wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase I clone trooper armor]] outfitted with a [[Kama/Legends|kama]], holsters for his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], and tank gunner padded [[Armor/Legends|armor]] on his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] and thick shoulder armor. The commander's armor was colored in [[Color/Legends|green]] to denote his unit affiliation to the rest of Bantha Squad.<ref name="Hasbro" />
